thread:
alex: Heads-up — CI integ suite is red on main: `integration/linux/pg-integ` failing with DB connection resets across the last 3 runs. Seen on ubuntu-22 runners. Error snippet: "connection reset by peer / socket hang up". Anyone taking a first look? :rotating_light:

ci-bot: Failed job: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/12345 (integration/linux/pg-integ) :x:

maria: @eng-infra-oncall can you grab the pgmock pod logs and node status? Is this env regression or test flake? :eyes:

jordan: I pulled logs from one failing run, pgmock pod is CrashLoopBackOff. Quick dump: 
```
$ kubectl -n ci get pods | grep pgmock
pgmock-0   0/1   CrashLoopBackOff   2   5m
$ kubectl -n ci logs pgmock-0
... E0707 12:34:56.789 connection reset by peer
... SIGKILL: killed by OOM killer
```

Looks like kernel OOM kills the container shortly after test starts (memory spike).

taylor: Noted similar pattern yesterday on a different runner. Node `ci-runner-8` showed memory pressure and multiple containers got OOM-killed around same time. Could be a change in the heavy-load test that allocates a large dataset.

alex: OK can someone try a rerun with a larger machine type and also reproduce locally with the same test subset? Command I used to rerun: `ci retry --build 12345 --machine-type=large`

ci-bot: Rerun triggered: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/12346 (machine-type=large) :white_check_mark:

maria: Rerun #12346 passed the pgmock pod startup but a second rerun failed again with same OOM pattern. So intermittent but reproducible under load. Marking as flaky for now.

jordan: We should quarantine the specific test(s) that cause the memory spike. Quick triage steps I propose: 1) bisect test subset to find culprit, 2) add temporary quarantine label on PRs, 3) increase pgmock pod memory requests to 1Gi to reduce noise.

taylor: Also please check pgmock image — upstream changelog mentions memory regression in v2.1.2. If we're on that tag, rolling back to v2.1.1 might be a quick mitigation.

eng-infra-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll: 1) bump pgmock requests/limits to 1Gi in CI namespace, 2) check node eviction events and image tag, 3) open an infra incident if node instability persists. ETA 30m.

alex: Thx. Maria — can you own the bisect this evening? If you find specific test, add it to `quarantine/integration-heavy` and ping PR authors to rerun after fix.

maria: On it. I'll bisect after standup and post results here. If we need to block the main rollout, we'll add the temporary skip. :+1:

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423 "CI pgmock OOM spikes causing integ flakiness" — assigned to eng-infra-oncall.https://incidents.redwood.com/INC-2026-0423

jordan: Quick note for bisect: start with `--filter=heavy-load` then narrow. If anyone wants to help run local repros, DM me, I have a repro script.

taylor: I'll also check the pgmock image history and open a vendor ticket if we confirm upstream regression.

alex: Good coordination — tagging `eng-platform` and `eng-infra` for follow-through. We'll keep this thread for updates.

maria: Update 45m: bumped pod memory, reruns are stable so far. Bisect scheduled for 19:00 PT. Will post failing test name or PR quarantine list after that.

jordan: Thanks — leaving follow-up items in the incident.

maria: Closing loop for now — will reopen if we see further failures. :white_check_mark:
